column1: # Additional particles that are not in the PDG tables of scikit-hep/particle.
# PDG IDs and names are fixed at build time: adding or removing a particle
# requires a rebuild. Masses and charges given here are the defaults; they can
# be changed at runtime without rebuilding by pointing the environment variable
# ACTS_ADDITIONAL_PARTICLES_CSV to a CSV file in the same format
# needs to list the particles whose values change.
